hook.text: Montepulciano is a town, not a grape.
hook.basis: Open Wine Atlas atlas_note and study lesson italy-toscana: Sangiovese, locally called Prugnolo Gentile, from the town of Montepulciano; not related to the Montepulciano grape (grown mainly in Abruzzo).

topical.event: none; Tuscany study path, Tuscany 2/2 after Brunello (announced in the Brunello outro)

station.name: Siena
station.service: Servizio Idrologico Regionale (SIR) Toscana, published by Consorzio LaMMA
station.note: Values reused from facts/deep-chianti-classico.json and facts/deep-brunello.json (LaMMA Siena page, 1991-2020). No official 1991-2020 normals for a station in Montepulciano were found in this run (searches returned only model-based weather sites). Siena is about 48 km WNW of the outline centre; named on screen. No sunshine on the page, so no Sun layer.
